title: New App Lets Users Borrow, Share Dogs

image.attribution: Elf at the English language Wikipedia / Wikimedia Commons / CC-BY-SA-3.0

main_content:
In a new twist on the so-called sharing economy, you can now enjoy the man’s best friend for just a short time.

Thanks to a new mobile app, dog lovers who aren’t ready to commit or are unable to own a dog, can borrow a pup for a short time or even overnight.

The service is called Bark’N’Borrow, and works similarly to Uber and Airbnb. Simply sign up, get verified, find the dog you want to borrow, pay a fee and off you go.

“This is the next best thing between not owning a dog and committing to one,” said Bark’N’Borrow CEO and Founder Liam Berkeley in an interview with Fox News.

According to FOX News, one user, Anna Browne, loves corgis but said she was not ready to have her own due to having a small apartment and often working late.

She used the app and found an owner willing to lend their corgi.

“It’s like a delight,” Browne told Fox. “On the weekend, if I can hang out with a corgi for a couple of hours, it’s amazing.”

The company, which says it has about 50,000 members nationwide, maintains that all users are fully vetted.

“We collect your residential info, your billing info, your address, your full details,” Berkeley told Fox.

“There are much easier ways to get your hands on a dog if you are that type of person that wants to hurt a dog or steal a dog than going through our platform and through our system. We try to do the utmost.”

questions.question: What can the new app be used for?
options: A platform for adopting pets permanently
A service to borrow a dog temporarily
A way to buy dog supplies
A network for dog training services
questions.answer: A service to borrow a dog temporarily

questions.question: How does the app work?
options: Users can swap pets with other users directly
It matches users with nearby dog owners for borrowing
It provides access to dog-walking services
Users can exclusively adopt dogs through the platform
questions.answer: It matches users with nearby dog owners for borrowing

questions.question: Why doesn’t Anna Browne have any pets?
options: She travels frequently and cannot care for pets
She dislikes animals and prefers not to own one
Her apartment is too small for a dog and her work schedule is demanding
She is saving money to buy a dog in the future
questions.answer: Her apartment is too small for a dog and her work schedule is demanding
